Name: MarniesProblemFix
Author: Mendonca2004
Description:
🌟 Marnies Problem Fix
Tired of showing up at Marnie's Ranch only to find the door locked, or Marnie standing right behind the counter ignoring your attempts to buy hay or animals because it's a Tuesday or her day off? This lightweight SMAPI mod fixes that annoyance while keeping vanilla immersion completely intact!

🛠️ Main Features:
[list]
[*][b]24/7 Porch Access[/b]: If you arrive at Marnie's shop and she isn't around, interacting with her front porch/door will instantly warp you inside the shop, ready for business.[/*]
[*][b]Full Counter Interaction[/b]: Click or face the shop counter inside at any time to open a quick, interactive selection menu.[/*]
[*][b]Complete Store Access[/b]: Choose between purchasing [b]Supplies[/b] (Hay, Ostrich Incubator, Auto-Petter, etc.) or [b]Animals[/b], granting total access regardless of her schedule, days off, or absence.[/*]
[/list]🚀 Getting Started & Configuration:
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] installed.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]On first run, the mod will automatically generate a
[code]config.json[/code]file where you can toggle the mod's features on or off if desired:[/*]
[/list]JSON

[code]{
  "EnableAlwaysOpen": true
}[/code]📋 Requirements:
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Marnies Problem Fix
Manifest.Description: Allows access to Marnie's full shop stock (supplies and animals) at any time, even when she is absent or the shop is closed.
